section: USA elements | for base units H. 84
family_naming_note: JOINS family H.84 rather than a namespaced 'USA H.84': unlike USA Tall H.210, these ARE H.84 base units - 840 on the 60 plinth, the BL / BM depth letters of base_h84.json. The section keeps the catalog's wording.
extraction_note: 2026-09-28, whole page: 18 codes, 4 types. Only the countertop-hob base is buildable (its stack derived, see notes); the two oven bases and the fridge doors are custom-sized and held for lookup. printed p.414, its H.78 twin, is still not extracted.

usa_base_countertop_hob.description: Base unit for countertop hob - 1 custom-sized jumbo drawer, 1 jumbo drawer

front_layout.note: Elevation printed p.415: lower jumbo 48 (handle) / 45 (gola), upper 'custom-sized'. Stack DERIVED from base_jumbo_drawers H.84 (36 / 48, gola 33 / 45) - see notes.
front_layout.gola_note: 33 + 45 = 78 of fronts; the two 30 mm zones are carried from H.78 as for the drawer stack - an inference, not printed.

usa_base_countertop_hob.notes: THE US-WIDTH BASE FOR A COOKTOP: 30, 36, 42 and 48 in, the same inch column as printed p.418 (nominal_widths_in). For 7612, BL9150 / BM9150 (914) is the width of the CIT36YWBB itself. The elevation prints only the LOWER drawer, 48 / 45; the upper is 'custom-sized'. The front stack here is that of base_jumbo_drawers at H.84 (360 / 480, gola 330 / 450), which is the default the sum rule leaves - a DERIVATION, trust indicative; a custom upper front is an order axis this file does not hold. Servo Drive p.567; LEGRABOX margin prices (215 / 65 / 280) named, not coded.
usa_base_countertop_hob.wall_hung_note: Hob flame beside d.62 and d.67. NO hung glyph and NO wall-hung margin line on printed p.415 - swept on the 150-dpi render 2026-09-28.
